newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish 4 PCT T-bill traded at initial 98.92.
newsitem.headline: Danish 4 PCT T-bill traded at initial 98.92.

text.p: The new Danish four percent, three-year treasury bill sold at 98.92, yielding 4.38 percent, at the start of the central bank's auction, a dealer said, adding that the initial one billion crown offer was fully subscribed.
A central bank statement earlier said that it would issue a maximum three billion crowns during the course of the day. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
